scope: independent source and disposable-fixture review of candidate full-platform driver, not a BSP or Android image build

findings_resolved.resolution: Product template and destination scans now reject special children. Existing destination and output paths must be directories. Negative cases prove rejection before source patches.
A log directory inside or equal to the materialized product is rejected before log creation or source patch mutation.
Every Git call disables core.fsmonitor and hooks. The original helper-marker reproducer now passes without helper execution.
No Git worktree diff is used. Raw tracked working bytes and modes are compared with Git blob IDs. A configured clean filter no longer executes for a same-content file whose timestamp changed.
Every Git call uses --no-replace-objects. An original HEAD pin paired with a replacement commit tree is rejected; no output or log directory is created.

independent_checks.author_full_contract_test_log: 36 tests pass. Shell and make orchestration fixtures are explicitly labelled and do not compile Android.

confirmed: Exact critical HEAD pins and raw untouched tracked bytes/modes are checked. Staged changes, assume-unchanged, skip-worktree, unknown source inputs and ignored build definitions are blocked within the explicit projects.
Patch-affected paths are compared with pristine or verified prefix states produced from Git blob bytes and actual git apply in scratch directories. Arbitrary partial patch states are rejected.

Default mode does not source envsetup/BSP build scripts or mutate BSP, output, log or product paths. It deliberately runs host Git, selected JDK/Python version commands and temporary scratch patch checks.

Only explicit --run applies source patches, copies the product and invokes genuine envsetup/lunch/make droid. No direct flash, mount or device command, vendor build.sh, source download or GitHub Actions call is present.
The kernel override uses a bounded regular-file read and an input-marker hash. This does not assert that the file is a valid kernel or compatible with the hardware.
The source patch plan leaves kernel building separate and does not enable recovery in the existing SD test product.
limits: Host executables and the control checkout are explicitly trusted. This is not a sandbox against concurrently changing source files or arbitrary host configuration.
Only critical overlay projects are validated. Other AOSP project states and generated-header origins are not authenticated.
Preflight is not a lock. Rechecks reduce ordinary mistakes but do not provide atomic rollback of multi-project patching or complete concurrency isolation.
An actual repo manifest -r, when available, is captured with provenance rather than fabricated. Absence or failure is reported; a candidate build may still run.
Passing fixtures does not establish source/module closure, an Android ROM, recovery/SD image, physical compatibility or boot.
